opening.argument: The video teaches possible ways to earn online, including listing freelance services or pitching businesses, while acknowledging the work and resources those routes may require. The promoted Digital Agency Launch Pad is described as a no-cost preview, and the screen displays a $1,000-$10,000+ monthly figure. Those promotional elements do not turn the discussion into proof of deception: the speaker does not assure viewers they can earn enough to quit a job, and says product-based businesses take time and more revenue to start. The supplied material does not show the destination's terms, a payment or data request, or any outcome. On this record, the earning figure and invitation to view the preview do not establish deceptive conduct.
